theater: 廣州至武漢的粵漢鐵路走廊

battle.name: 北伐戰爭
battle.theater: 廣州至武漢的粵漢鐵路走廊
battle.brief: 民國十五年七月，國民革命軍自廣州誓師北伐，以粵漢鐵路為軸，先取兩湖，再下江西，終及直奉。汀泗橋與賀勝橋一夜突破直系主力，武昌十日內易手，推進的骨架從此是槍砲與鐵路。卡面所配的加特林機槍是南北戰爭時期的六管人力速射砲，到一九二六年早已被水冷重機槍取代，未曾隨軍作戰。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 北伐戰爭由廣州國民政府與北京政府兩邊的軍閥聯軍，在華南至華北的廣闊戰線上展開，交戰主體是國民革命軍對直系、奉系兩大軍閥集團。國民革命軍方面，1925年7月1日以原廣州軍政府轄下部隊改組而成，成立之初正式編制為六個軍，兵力約八萬五千人；1926年7月出師前擴編為八個軍，由蔣中正以國民革命軍總司令兼總參謀長統率，國民政府主席譚延闓坐鎮廣州主持後方，黨代表制貫穿各級，黃埔軍校出身的將校為軍隊骨幹。直系方面，吳佩孚據兩湖，孫傳芳掌江蘇、浙江、安徽、福建，齊燮元守江蘇，馬聯甲主安徽，兵力合計二十餘萬，多為舊式陸軍與地方保安團。奉系方面，張作霖以東三省為根據地，張學良掌軍，張宗昌的直魯聯軍與湯玉麟等部駐守關內，1927年張作霖自稱安國軍總司令。此外，山西閻錫山保持中立，陝甘馮玉祥的西北軍於1926年9月在五原誓師後加入革命軍行列，湖南唐生智、廣西李宗仁等地方部隊亦在同一面旗幟之下。蘇聯以軍事顧問、紅槍隊教官、黃埔教練與大批軍火飛機提供援助，共產黨則以黨代表身份參與軍事工作。北線另有英美支持的直系殘部與日本關東軍形成牽制，北伐自始至終帶著國際力量對峙的影子。
countriesEn: The Northern Expedition was fought between the forces of the Guangzhou National Government and the Beijing government, the line of contact running across a vast front from South China to North China, with the National Revolutionary Army on one side and the two great warlord blocs, Zhili and Fengtian, on the other. On the revolutionary side the NRA was created on 1 July 1925 by reorganising the troops of the former Guangzhou military government; at its founding it was formally organised into six armies of about 85,000 men, and before it marched in July 1926 it had been expanded to eight armies. Chiang Kai-shek took command as Commander-in-Chief of the National Revolutionary Army and Chief of the General Staff, the National Government under Chairman Tan Yankai remained behind in Guangzhou to run the rear areas, the system of party representatives ran through every level of the force, and graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy formed its backbone. On the Zhili side Wu Peifu held the two Huguang provinces, Sun Chuanfang controlled Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui and Fujian, Qi Xieyuan garrisoned Jiangsu and Ma Lianjia held Anhui, together something over 200,000 men, mostly old-line troops and local militia. On the Fengtian side Zhang Zuolin used the three northeastern provinces as his base, Zhang Xueliang held the army, the Zhili-Lu coalition of Zhang Zongchang and troops such as Tang Yulin's were posted inside the Great Wall, and in 1927 Zhang Zuolin proclaimed himself Commander-in-Chief of the Army for the Pacification of the Country. Shanxi under Yan Xishan stayed neutral, and the northwestern army of Feng Yuxiang in Shaanxi and Gansu joined the revolutionary ranks after the proclamation at Wuyuan in September 1926; the Hunan troops of Tang Shengzhi and the Guangxi troops of Li Zongren likewise came under the same banner. The Soviet Union supplied military advisers, Red Army instructors, Whampoa trainers and large quantities of ordnance and aircraft, and the Communists took part in the military work through the system of party representatives. In the northern sector, Zhili remnants backed by Britain and the United States and the Japanese Kwantung Army formed a counterweight, so the campaign carried the shadow of an international balance of forces from first to last.
people: 北伐時期在前線操盤的，是一批新式軍事精英與舊軍閥宿將的正面對撞。蔣中正以總司令身份自1926年7月誓師起就在前線督戰，先取兩湖、再取江西、直下江蘇，1927年4月在上海實施清黨，寧漢分裂之後又主持二次北伐，終於在1928年把旗幟插進北京與奉系控制的地盤。譚延闓出任國民政府主席，統著湘軍與後方籌糧；唐生智以第八軍軍長身份倒戈湖南，率部成為攻取武昌的主力；李宗仁掌第七軍，出兵兩廣並支援江西方向；何應欽任總參謀長，白崇禧以參謀長身份在前線協調各路，魯滌平統率第二軍在湖南正面壓上。葉挺以第四軍獨立團團長的身份，率五百人起家的小部隊打響名聲，汀泗橋夜襲與賀勝橋追擊全靠他親自帶隊，團內黨代表為廖乾五，黃埔政治部主任周恩來則在革命軍中擔任政治工作的樞紐。對面的吳佩孚是直系總司令，兩湖崩潰後潛居北平租界；孫傳芳在江西與浙江連敗，退守江浙；張作霖掌奉系，1927年稱安國軍總司令，一心以武力統一，1928年6月4日在京奉鐵路皇姑屯附近遇炸身亡；張學良承接奉系，1928年12月29日宣布東北大軍服從南京國民政府。馮玉祥在五原誓師，率西北軍加入革命軍，其後卻與蔣中正分道；閻錫山守住山西，一度阻止革命軍入晉。
peopleEn: The Northern Expedition was run at the front by a head-on collision between a new generation of military graduates and the old warlord veterans. Chiang Kai-shek, as Commander-in-Chief, was in the front line from the oath-taking of July 1926, taking the two Huguang provinces first, then Jiangxi, then driving down into Jiangsu; in April 1927 he carried out the party purge in Shanghai, and after the Nanjing-Wuhan split he led the Second Northern Expedition, until in 1928 he planted the flag in Beijing and in the territory held by the Fengtian clique. Tan Yankai was chairman of the National Government, directed the Hunan armies and handled the supply of the rear areas. Tang Shengzhi, as commander of the 8th Army, came over to the revolution in Hunan and his troops became the main force in the assault on Wuchang; Li Zongren commanded the 7th Army out of Guangxi and supported the Jiangxi direction; He Yingqin was Chief of the General Staff and Bai Chongxi coordinated the several columns at the front as a staff officer, while Lu Diping led the 2nd Army in the frontal drive across Hunan. Ye Ting, as commander of the Independent Regiment of the 4th Army, made his name with a small unit that began with five hundred men: the night attack at Tingsi Bridge and the pursuit at Hesheng Bridge were both led by him in person, the regiment's party representative was Liao Qianwu, and Zhou Enlai, head of political work at the Whampoa Military Academy, was the pivot of political work inside the revolutionary army. On the other side Wu Peifu was commander in chief of the Zhili forces and, after the collapse of the two Huguang provinces, lived in hiding in the foreign concessions at Beiping; Sun Chuanfang was defeated in Jiangxi and in Zhejiang and fell back into the lower Yangtze; Zhang Zuolin held the Fengtian forces, proclaimed himself Commander-in-Chief of the Anguo Army in 1927 and tried to hold the country together by force, and was killed by a bomb near Huanggutun on the Beijing-Shenyang railway on 4 June 1928; Zhang Xueliang inherited the Fengtian armies and on 29 December 1928 declared the allegiance of the armies of the Northeast to the Nanjing National Government. Feng Yuxiang proclaimed his men at Wuyuan and brought the northwestern army into the revolutionary ranks, though he later parted ways with Chiang Kai-shek, while Yan Xishan held Shanxi shut and for a time kept the revolutionary army out of the province.
kits: 卡面這件加特林機槍是1860年美國南北戰爭初期由理查德·加特林設計的六管人力轉動速射砲，靠手搖曲柄帶動六根槍管依次發射，靠彈殼與火藥燃燒的推力自轉，靠後坐力分散在六次射擊之中，因而能壓住一個展開面；在1860年代，它是唯一能在數秒之內傾瀉數百發的機關火器，一度被北方各鎮當作守備重裝備。清末江南製造總局曾仿製「格林炮」，此後數十年仍散見於各省軍械庫與邊防守備，但它到1926年早已被水冷式重機槍取代，出廠近七十年的老砲不可能隨軍作戰。北伐軍真正倚重的是蘇聯援助的莫辛-那甘式步槍、蘇造與仿德的水冷重機槍，以及漢陽兵工廠的八八式步槍和各地繳獲的舊槍；重火力集中在七五毫米山炮、迫擊砲與大量配發的碰炸手榴彈上。攻武昌時，團營級迫擊砲的射擊與連續的手榴彈拋射是清除城頭碉堡的主要手段，機槍則壓制城牆射擊孔，步兵再以刺刀與大刀作白刃衝鋒。單兵裝備是步槍、刺刀、四套餐具與一把大刀，彈藥靠人背肩挑，補給依賴粵漢鐵路的火車與民間卡車；通信用有線電話、無線電報與傳令騎兵，頭頂則有蘇維埃教練機與張輝瓚率領的飛機隊偵察，並對江上艦隊實施轟炸。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Gatling gun, the six-barrel hand-cranked rapid-fire gun designed by Richard Gatling in 1860 at the opening of the American Civil War. The barrels fired in sequence as the handle was turned, the cartridges and the gas of the burnt propellant kept the mechanism revolving, and the recoil was spread over six separate shots, which allowed it to hold down a whole line of attack. In the 1860s it was the only weapon able to pour out several hundred rounds in a few seconds, and the northern garrisons treated it as heavy defensive equipment. The Jiangnan Arsenal in the late Qing produced copies of it under the name qilinpao, and such pieces lingered in provincial arsenals and border garrisons for decades afterwards, but by 1926 the Gatling had long been superseded by the water-cooled heavy machine gun, and a design nearly seventy years old could not have gone into the field with an army. What the Northern Expedition actually relied on were Mosin-Nagant rifles and Soviet-made or German-pattern water-cooled heavy machine guns supplied from the Soviet Union, together with the Hanyang Arsenal's Type 88 rifle and quantities of captured old weapons; the heavy firepower was concentrated in 75 mm mountain guns, mortars and a large issue of impact-fuse hand grenades. In the assault on Wuchang the fire of battalion and regimental mortars and a steady stream of grenades were the principal means of clearing the pillboxes on the ramparts, machine guns suppressed the firing slits in the city wall, and the infantry closed in with bayonets and broadswords. On the individual soldier were a rifle, a bayonet, a haversack and a broadsword, ammunition was carried on backs and shoulders, and supply ran on trains of the Canton-Wuchang railway and on civilian lorries; communications were by field telephone, wireless telegraph and mounted orderly, while overhead the Soviet trainer aircraft and the air force led by Zhang Huizhan supplied reconnaissance and bombed riverine units.
tactics: 北伐的戰術主軸是沿鐵路軸線做連續的攻勢運動，並把兵力和火力集中到一個方向。蔣中正出任總司令後即主張集中使用兵力，反對湘鄂兩路平分兵力、各自求功，因此主力自廣州沿粵漢鐵路北上，湖南正面由第二軍、第八軍交替攻擊，敵軍節節抵抗之後退入鄂境。奪取車站、橋樑與鐵路沿線據點是每一步的固定目標，因為鐵路同時是推進軸線、補給線與敵軍撤退線。攻堅手段以迫擊砲與山炮壓制城頭機槍射孔，然後步兵以手榴彈與密集隊形突入；葉挺獨立團在汀泗橋以夜襲奪陣，賀勝橋以正面突破配合迂迴追擊，連續四天擊潰直系主力，把戰線推到武昌城下。攻下武昌後，部隊以鐵路分批北送，指揮部靠火車與汽車調動整個縱隊。敵軍大量倒戈也構成戰術的一部分：直系與奉系的基層部隊在革命軍節節勝利後成建制繳械投誠，革命軍每佔一城就大量擴編，把新繳的槍砲補入作戰單位。空軍與騎兵規模有限，主要用於偵察、追擊散兵與掩護鐵路運輸；後勤則靠徵用民船、火車與大批徵發的湖南農民挑夫，糧食在沿線就地徵收。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the Northern Expedition was a continuous offensive along a railway line, with troops and firepower concentrated on a single direction. Once he took command Chiang Kai-shek pressed the principle of concentrating all force and opposed the division of the army between the Hunan and the Hubei routes, each of which sought credit of its own; the main body therefore moved north from Guangzhou along the Canton-Wuchang railway, with the 2nd and 8th armies taking turns in the frontal drive through Hunan, while the enemy gave ground step by step into Hubei. Seizing stations, bridges and railway-side positions was the fixed objective of every step, because the railway was at once the axis of advance, the supply line and the enemy's line of retreat. In assaults, mortars and mountain guns suppressed the machine-gun embrasures of the fortifications and the infantry then went in with grenades in close formation; Ye Ting's Independent Regiment took a position by night attack at Tingsi Bridge, and at Hesheng Bridge combined a frontal break with an outflanking pursuit, breaking the Zhili main force in four days and pushing the front to the walls of Wuchang. After Wuchang fell, the troops were moved north in batches by rail, and the headquarters moved whole columns about by train and motor car. The mass defection of enemy troops formed part of the method as well: Zhili and Fengtian units at the lower levels laid down their arms and came over in formed bodies as the revolution advanced, and every city taken was used to expand the army, feeding newly captured rifles and guns into the combat units. Air and cavalry were of limited size and served mainly for reconnaissance, for rounding up broken troops and for escorting railway transport; the rear was supplied by commandeered boats, trains and large numbers of Hunan peasant porters conscripted to carry food, which was requisitioned along the line.
data: 可核對的數字大致是這樣：國民革命軍1925年7月建軍時正式編制六個軍、兵力約八萬五千人，1926年7月誓師北伐時擴編為八個軍，出師部隊約十萬人，分作三路指向湘、鄂、贛三個方向；吳佩孚麾下直系軍的總數在二十萬上下，孫傳芳在江浙皖閩的兵力約二十餘萬，張作霖的奉系與關內部隊約三十餘萬。戰果方面，1926年10月10日革命軍攻入武昌，11月初孫傳芳退出南昌，1927年3月占領南京，1928年4月開始二次北伐，同年6月奉軍退出北京，12月29日東北大軍宣布服從南京國民政府。獨立團以五百人之眾起家，經汀泗橋、賀勝橋兩戰之後擴充到六千人，官方對這兩戰的通報稱俘虜四千餘人、繳槍萬餘支，敵軍一個師的建制被打散；武昌攻城歷時七日，守軍一萬餘人崩潰。二次北伐蔣系出動約四十萬人，沿津浦路推進至滄州、靜海一線。鐵路控制線是另一個量尺：革命軍先後控制粵漢、隴海、京漢、津浦等幹線，全線長度以萬公里計。蘇聯援助累計供給步槍數十萬支、機槍數百挺、迫擊砲與野炮數百門、卡車數百輛、飛機數十架，這批軍火構成了北伐初期全部的重火力來源。以上數字多出自當時的戰報與官方統計，彼此出入甚大，只能當作量級參考，而不是精確統計。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. When the National Revolutionary Army was founded in July 1925 it was formally organised into six armies of about 85,000 men; when it swore the oath to march north in July 1926 it had been expanded to eight armies, and the force that set out numbered about 100,000 men, split into three columns pointing at Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi. The Zhili armies under Wu Peifu numbered around 200,000 in all, Sun Chuanfang's troops in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui and Fujian something over 200,000, and Zhang Zuolin's Fengtian forces and those inside the Great Wall around 300,000. On results: the revolutionary army entered Wuchang on 10 October 1926; Sun Chuanfang withdrew from Nanchang in early November; Nanjing was taken in March 1927; the Second Northern Expedition opened in April 1928; the Fengtian forces left Beijing in June of that year; and on 29 December the armies of the Northeast declared for the Nanjing National Government. The Independent Regiment began with five hundred men and was expanded to six thousand after the fighting at Tingsi Bridge and Hesheng Bridge; the official reports of those two actions claimed more than four thousand prisoners and over ten thousand rifles captured, and a whole enemy division was scattered. The siege of Wuchang lasted seven days and the garrison of more than 10,000 men broke up. In the Second Northern Expedition Chiang's group fielded about 400,000 men and drove up the Tientsin-Pukow line as far as Cangzhou and Chinghai. The length of railway under control is another measure of scale: the Canton-Wuchang, the Lunghai, the Peking-Hankow and the Tientsin-Pukow trunk lines, thousands of kilometres in all. Soviet aid over the period supplied hundreds of thousands of rifles, several hundred machine guns, several hundred mortars and field guns, several hundred lorries and several dozen aircraft, and this stock was the entire source of heavy firepower for the early phase of the expedition. Most of these numbers come from contemporary battle reports and official statistics that differ widely from one another; they should be read as orders of magnitude and not as precise counts.
cause: 北伐的起因是一連串政治、社會與國際因素疊加的結果。第一層是帝國主義壓力：列強在華的特區、租界與關稅、礦產權益上步步進逼，1919年五四運動之後，民族主義訴求從學生街頭走向軍隊與商界，要求收回主權、廢除不平等條約。第二層是軍閥割據：直系、奉系與其他大小軍閥長期混戰，稅收分據，鐵路與礦山被當作私產，廣東、湖南、湖北一帶的商路與農民生活被兵火與攤派反覆摧殘，統一遂成為民生要求。第三層是黨的路線：孫中山在1924年改組國民黨，確立聯俄容共與改組國民革命軍的方針，把打倒列強的口號接上打倒軍閥的目標，並以黃埔軍校與蘇聯援助建立自己的武力；1925年孫中山逝世，國民黨內部需要一次軍事勝利，來確定黨國體制的繼承人。導火索則是直系對工人運動的鎮壓：1923年二七慘案之後工運受挫，1925年五卅慘案又激起全國反帝浪潮，唐生智等湖南軍頭在1926年夏天倒戈，把北伐的機會窗口打開。於是1926年7月9日廣州誓師，以統一全國為目標的北伐正式開始。
causeEn: The origins of the Northern Expedition lay in a pile-up of political, social and international causes. The first was imperial pressure: the powers kept advancing their hold over the special areas, the concessions, the customs revenue and the mining rights in China, and after the May Fourth movement of 1919 the demand for national self-determination moved out of the student demonstrations and into the army and the merchant community, calling for the recovery of sovereignty and the abolition of the unequal treaties. The second was the fragmentation of the country by the warlords: the Zhili, the Fengtian and the lesser cliques had been fighting one another for years, taxes were divided among them, railways and mines were treated as private property, and the trade routes and the peasant life of Guangdong, Hunan and Hubei were repeatedly ruined by war and by levies, so that unity had become a question of livelihood. The third was the line of the party: in 1924 Sun Yat-sen reorganised the Kuomintang, set out the policy of alliance with Russia and accommodation of the Communists, converted the call to overthrow the imperialists into a call to overthrow the imperialists and the warlords, and built his own armed force on the Whampoa Military Academy and on Soviet aid; after Sun's death in 1925 the party needed a military victory in order to settle the succession to the party-state system. The immediate trigger was the suppression of the labour movement by the Zhili clique: after the February 7th massacre of 1923 the workers' movement was checked, and the May Thirtieth incident of 1925 raised a nationwide anti-imperialist wave, while warlord commanders such as Tang Shengzhi in Hunan came over during the summer of 1926 and opened the window of opportunity. Hence the oath-taking at Guangzhou on 9 July 1926, and the Northern Expedition began with the declared aim of unifying the country.
impact: 北伐的影響在當時與其後都極為深遠。就當時而言，革命軍在不到兩年之內擊潰直系與奉系在關內的主力，1928年12月29日東北大軍宣布服從南京國民政府，至少在形式上結束了自1916年以來十餘年的軍閥割據，中央政府的號令第一次能沿著鐵路傳到東北。商路、稅源與教育行政隨統一而重新編排，各省財政與軍政人事大幅更替，北方民眾首次感受到單一政權的存在。國際層面，列強在華的租界與特區權益受到衝擊，漢口與九江租界於1927年初相繼收回，外國觀察者對革命軍的態度也出現分歧，長期支持吳佩孚的英方轉為觀望。與此同時，蘇聯在中國的影響急升，黃埔體系、黨代表制與政治工作制度在軍隊中扎下根，日後成為國民政府的建軍骨架。負面的後果同樣沉重：1927年4月的清黨與寧漢分裂，讓國民革命軍在建軍最關鍵的時刻自相殘殺，第十一師等建制被繳械，軍隊的派系化由此開始；日本的干涉從濟南到皇姑屯一步步加深，東北方局埋下隱憂；國民政府雖取得名義上的統一，軍閥舊部改掛番號而實力仍存，統一的脆弱很快在蔣桂戰爭與中原大戰中顯現。
impactEn: The effects of the Northern Expedition were profound both at the time and afterwards. In the immediate term the revolutionary army destroyed the main body of the Zhili and Fengtian forces inside the Great Wall in less than two years, and when the armies of the Northeast declared for the Nanjing National Government on 29 December 1928 the more than ten years of warlord partition that had run since 1916 came to an end at least in form: for the first time the orders of a central government could travel to the Northeast along the railway lines. Trade routes, sources of revenue and education administration were reorganised along with the unity, provincial finances and military and civil appointments were replaced wholesale, and the people of the north for the first time felt the presence of a single government. At the international level the concession and special-area privileges of the foreign powers were challenged, the concessions at Hankow and Jiujiang were recovered in early 1927, and foreign observers divided in their attitude toward the revolutionary army, with Britain, which had long backed Wu Peifu, turning cautious. At the same time Soviet influence in China rose quickly: the Whampoa system, the system of party representatives and the institutions of political work took root in the army and were to form the bones of the National Government's military system. The negative consequences were just as heavy. The party purge of April 1927 and the Nanjing-Wuhan split made the National Revolutionary Army tear itself apart at the critical moment of its build-up; formations such as the 11th Division were disarmed, and the factionalisation of the army began there. Japanese interference deepened step by step from the Jinan incident to Huanggutun, leaving a hidden danger in the northeast. And although the National Government gained a nominal unity, the old warlord units changed their labels while keeping their real strength, and the fragility of that unity soon showed itself in the Chiang-Guangxi war and in the Central Plains War.
result: 打到最後的結果是一個統一的名義加一個未解決的現實。1926年7月誓師，到1928年12月29日東北大軍通電服從南京國民政府，前後約兩年半，國民革命軍占領了絕大多數省份，控制了粵漢、隴海、津浦等主要鐵路；吳佩孚的直系主力在兩湖崩解，孫傳芳的江浙部隊被逐出安徽與福建，張作霖本人則在1928年6月4日於京奉鐵路皇姑屯附近遇炸身亡，關內的奉系部隊隨後退出北京。二次北伐之後，南京成為首都，北京改稱北平，國民革命軍的番號體系擴充到數十個軍，兵員以十萬計。但統一並不鞏固：舊軍閥部隊大批改掛國民革命軍番號而保留實力，閻錫山控制山西，馮玉祥的西北軍與中央貌合神離，張學良在東北仍握軍政大權；1929年起的蔣桂戰爭、中原大戰接踵而至，說明北伐真正解決的只是軍閥割據的表層問題，國家的軍隊現代化與財政統一遠未完成，等到抗日戰爭爆發時，扛住外敵的仍是一支體制混雜的軍隊。
resultEn: The eventual result was a nominal unity resting on an unresolved reality. From the oath-taking of July 1926 to the declaration by the armies of the Northeast of their allegiance to the Nanjing National Government on 29 December 1928, a matter of some two and a half years, the National Revolutionary Army took most of the provinces, took control of the main trunk railways - the Canton-Wuchang, the Lunghai and the Tientsin-Pukow - broke the main body of Wu Peifu's Zhili armies in the two Huguang provinces, drove Sun Chuanfang's Jiangsu and Zhejiang troops out of Anhui and Fujian, and saw Zhang Zuolin himself killed by a bomb near Huanggutun on the Beijing-Shenyang railway on 4 June 1928, after which the Fengtian forces inside the Great Wall withdrew from Beijing. After the Second Northern Expedition Nanjing became the capital and Beijing was renamed Beiping, and the designation system of the National Revolutionary Army expanded to dozens of armies with hundreds of thousands of men. But the unity was not solid: great numbers of former warlord units changed their labels to NRA designations while keeping their real strength, Yan Xishan held Shanxi, Feng Yuxiang's northwestern army and the centre were formally in step and spiritually apart, and Zhang Xueliang still held military and civil power in the Northeast. From the Chiang-Guangxi war of 1929 and the Central Plains War that followed, it was clear that the Northern Expedition had settled only the surface of the warlord problem; the modernisation of the national army and the unification of the finances were far from achieved, and when full-scale war with Japan began the country was still carrying the burden on a mixed and uneven military system.
